item.description:
#Highlights!

* Lowest ticket price in the harbor!

* Guarantee Policy: 
No refunds if not seen, wildlife is NOT guaranteed. Come Again Free if not seen/not satisfied! This is based on available an hour before the tour you'd like to go on again.

* 13 guest max! 
Other boats 20 to 50 people.

* 144,000 lm of dive light power!
More than other boats.
Which statistically the more light power you have the more manta you can accumulate.
( of course they are wild animals, so that does not always guaranteed We have most mantas but but it certainly increases our chances )

* 3 minute boat ride to the manta ray site!
Most of the boats have the 30 minute boat ride from the other Harbor, which is 1 hour round-trip.

* We offer later tours than any other boat to give you the chance to have more Mantas, and more time with the Mantas, without all the other competitors out there, striving to see the same mantas.
But we still do offer the same early tours as well 

## Statistic on Manta Viewing 

The later at night you go the better statistically, but that is not a guarantee.

At sunset the manta site has the most boats which makes it more crowded and you have to share how ever many Manta’s their are with all the other boats. 

Every hour that passes after sunset more Boats leave the site, which gives us a better opportunity to have more Mantas or more time with the mantas underneath our light board. 

The number of Mantas we have every night ranges from 0 to 40 
but 10 manta rays is average per night!

## Tour Duration Time & Delays

About a 3 minute boat ride to the site

1 hour 20 minute tour approximately 
from start to finish. That is from the time you check in to the time you head back to your vehicle.

starting from the time you check in, to the time you’re taking your wetsuits off to head back to your vehicle.

Approximately 30 minute in water snorkel time

The tour duration time is NOT exact.
Water time is not exact.
Don't expect a set schedule on this tour.

This is a Wildlife tour and there are many variables. 

( weather conditions, manta ray sightings, boat traffic at the dock, etc. )

All of this can cause delays in the tour. 
Which could make us run a few minutes late to an hour or even more late. This is just the nature of this specific type of tour with any operator.

##Gear:

- Pool Noodle, Mask & Snorkel included

*Prescription mask NOT available,
 rent from Snorkel bobs or Boss frog

-Optional clothing gear,
Wetsuits are NOT necessary to get in the water or do the tour!
But provide extra warmth if needed.
70 - 80° degrees all year round! About the average temperature of some swimming pools. Please inquire with the host upon your arrival.

##Tour Details:

- The Manta show is a must do for everyone, Kona being one of the only places in the world to experience the Manta Night Snorkel! These magnificent creatures range in size from 5ft wide-18ft wide and have an average wingspan between 8 & 12ft wide.

- 3 minute boat ride to viewing site.
- About 80 minutes total 
( Approximately 30 minutes of in water snorkel time)

##Terms and conditions policies

*If no manta rays seen / not satisfied 
come again for free! 
No Refunds

*Tour Delays

*Check in time changes

*We recommend to be under 275 pounds

*If you purchase tickets, you agree to the terms and conditions policies.
item.booking_notes:
ALOHA! 
MUST READ EVERYTHING BELOW:

No Touching Manta Rays, Zero Tolerance.

****Manta Ray Guarantee Policy:

Join us again for FREE if no manta rays showed up. NO REFUNDS are issued. Why?

We cannot guarantee that wildlife will be present all night long, some nights they come and go & boat charters companies have expenses to operate the service we are providing. 

We guarantee you will see them as long as you take advantage of rebooking with us whether it’s on this vacation or your next one to Hawaii.

You can rebook your tour as many times as needed on your vacation (subject to your & our availability). If you’re not able to see them on another trip or rebook on your current vacation, your rain check tickets will be available anytime in the future.

Make sure your tour date is not scheduled on the last days of your vacation so you have flexibility to rebook if needed. 

Manta rays are wild animals, and their presence can never be guaranteed. While we do our absolute best to take you to the right place at the right time, we cannot control nature.

If your ticket was discounted, when you come on a re-ride you will have to pay the remaining funds for it to be a regular ticket price


****EQUIPTMENT:

• Mask & snorkel
• Floatation life belt / noodle 

Are included on your ticket price!
These items are necessary and mandatory to do the tour. 

• Rental /cleaning fee. 
$10 lifejacket ( 12 & Younger FREE )
$15 upper body jacket wetsuit 
$30 shorty full body wetsuit 
$30 floating waterproof phone case 
for purchase 
( based upon availability )

Wetsuits, lifejackets & Fins are NOT necessary or mandatory to do the tour. 




****TOUR DURATION & DELAY POLICY:

We can depart late upon rare situations.
Tour durations time and departure times are estimates — not exact. 

Delays are normal in this industry especially with this particular tour up to an 1 hour late.
We will notify you if so, so you don’t show early.

Delays can occur due to:
Weather conditions
Boat traffic
Mechanical issues
Wildlife sightseeing issues 
Other unforeseen circumstances

We do not issue refunds for delays or rescheduling.
Please do not schedule anything within 1 hour before or after your tour.

Allow a 1-hour buffer before/after your scheduled time.




****BOAT CAPACITY POLICY:

Minimum of 8 guests required for a tour to operate.
If the tour doesn't meet this minimum, we’ll move you to another time or day,
Not Refunded.
You will be contacted at least 30 minutes prior if your tour needs to be rescheduled.
(This rarely happens.)




****ABOUT THE BOAT:

RIB Zodiac Navy Seal Vessel 




****TOUR LENGTH:

Approximately 40 - 50 minutes from dock to dock

From check-in to check out approximately 
1 hour and 30 minutes.

Average water time is 
Approximately 30 minutes depending on many different situations



****RESTRICTIONS:

For your safety, guests must:

•MUST KNOW HOW TO SWIM AND TREAD WATER WITH YOUR OWN STRENGTH
•Be physically able to climb up a boat ladder
•Must weigh less than 275 LBS
•Not have back/neck problem
•Must be 5 years old minimum 
•Must be able to communicate in English for your safety with all of our instructions on the tour. 




****WHAT TO BRING:

Must wear and arrive in swimsuits.
Sandals ok
If you rented a lifejacket or wetsuit, please bring it.

Phone
Vehicle keys
Wallet 
Towel
Small Bag no bigger than a football

We keep the items above in a container for you at check in van location.

Gratuity Tip for your captain & crew if wanted!



****REVIEW POLICY

By purchasing tickets, you agree not to leave negative or retaliatory reviews due to situations out of our control such as:

Bad weather
Mechanical issues
Minimum guest capacity not being met
Delayed / Tours running late 
or rescheduled tours
WILD ANIMALS not being present



****UNDERSTAND THAT THERE ARE INHERENT RISKS INVOLVED WITH SNORKELING AND BOATING, included but not limited to equipment failure, perils of the sea, Physical and mental harm or death caused by marine creatures including bites & stings, acts of fellow participants, entering and exiting the water, boarding or disembarking boats, boating accident and activities on the docks and I HEREBY ASSUME SUCH RISKS. There is no refunds if this listed above occurs. 


**** All Sales are Final.
No Refund dispute back charges with banks / credit or debit cards, Doing so would be fraud and will be handled legally with our attorney.
If you would like a refund, you must do so within our policy, which is 72 hours before the tour with a phone call only, NOT email.
If a refund is needed because we cancel the tour, we will refund it for you on our end.


****TOUR CHECK-IN TIME:

The time you selected / purchased 
is your check-in time.

The boat will depart / leave the dock approximately 20 to 30 minutes after your check in time.

Recommended to show up 10 minutes before your check in time to find parking,
please do not check in before your check in time. 

if you’re late to your check in time, there’s a possibility you will miss the tour. There are no refunds. 


****CHECK IN ADDRESS: 

78-7100 Kaleiopapa st.
Kailua-Kona, Hawaii 96740

DO NOT PARK IN THE TRAILER STALLS - YOU WILL BE TOWED / TICKETED.

FREE PARKING ON THE SIDE OF THE STREET IS AVAILABLE…!

FREE PARKING IN THE BEACH PARKING LOT BY THE OUTRIGGER HOTEL.

Meet at the Tall White Rental Wetsuit Van across the street entrance of the OUT RIGGER RESORT & SPA sign with tall palm trees with Christmas lights and tiki torches. 

The address provided is the correct road/street, but does not take you directly to where the check-in van is.

After you are done with this check in process at van, they will send you down to the boat ramp 
There will NOT be an employee at the dock. 
The crew will get you from underneath the light pole upon returning from previous trip. Please do not roam around, remain underneath the light pole.
There will be no refunds or reschedules if you miss the boat.

Provide a working USA phone number to contact you if needed. 
Stay available and responsive on the day of your tour.
